evidence: Nep. Eum. 3: adversāriī (Lewis & Short s.v. Eurōpa)

phrases.latin: Tōta Eurōpa inter nōs et avum jacet.
phrases.english: All of Europe lies between us and Grandpa.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
